corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez word across L22-L23 is 'መዋሐዊት' (4th order ዋ, from መዋሐዊ 'oceanic/billowing'), not 'መዊሐዊት'.
The canonical Ge'ez citation is 'ሕግሰ መዋሐዊት ተፈ ፍርኃት' ('the Law is a billowing sea of fear'); the glyph after 'ተፈ' is clearly 'ፍ' ('ፍርኃት'), not 'ነ'.
Canonical Matthew 12:4 Ge'ez text and the printed image clearly read 'ኅብስተ ቍርባን' (bread of the presence/offering), where 'ስተ' was misread as 'ወዘ'.
The printed character at the end of the line is 'ስ' forming 'ይስዕርዋ' (matching L03 'ይስዕርዋ'), not 'ሥ'.
The word wrapping from L17 'ምሳ↵ሌውን' (the type/symbol, contrasting with 'አማናዊ ቤተ መቅደስ እኔን' in L19-20) clearly has 'ው' at the start of L18, not 'ያ'.
The printed glyph in 'መሥዋዕት' is 6th-order 'ሥ', not 1st-order 'ሠ'.
